title: Sound Bath, Sips, and Tarot
description: Sip spooky mocktails, receive a 3-card tarot reading, and unwind with a relaxing sound bath and Yoga Nidra experience.
long_description:
Sip spooky mocktails, receive a 3-card tarot reading, and unwind with a relaxing sound bath and Yoga Nidra experience.

About this Event

Step into an enchanting evening of sound, intuition, and community connection.
Your experience will begin with a welcome mocktail..... choose between a spooky Blood Moon Shirley Temple or Witch’s Rosé, a non-alcoholic sparkling rosé. Water and tea will also be available.
Upon check-in, you will receive a three-card intuitive tarot pull to keep. Your 3 physical tarot cards will be accompanied by a pre-prepared written reading exploring the cards’ meanings and the intuitive message they may hold for you.
Once everyone is settled, you will be guided through a deeply relaxing Sound Bath and Yoga Nidra experience featuring crystal singing bowls, soothing instruments, and guided rest. No previous experience is needed, simply get comfortable, close your eyes, and allow yourself to receive. A comfortable yoga bed, pillow, blanket, and bolster will be preset for every participant.
After the sound bath, we will gather for community connection, additional mocktails, and an optional discussion of your tarot cards and intuitive reading. Oracle decks and charm divination sets will also be available for anyone who would like to continue exploring.
Your experience includes:
One welcome Halloween-inspired mocktail3 physical tarot cards to keepOne prepared intuitive tarot readingA guided Sound Bath and Yoga Nidra experienceTime for community connection and tarot discussionAccess to oracle cards and charm divination setsAdditional mocktails, tea, and waterEverything you need to relax will be provided. Just wear comfortable clothing and arrive ready for a magical evening.
Tarot, oracle cards, and charm divination are offered for personal reflection and entertainment purposes only. They are not substitutes for medical, legal, financial, or mental health advice.
